title: Database Foundation
description: Establishes Kysely database integration, typed schema definitions, and a single migration that creates all tables with constraints and indexes.
acceptance_criteria: DatabaseModule is decorated with @Global() and exports DatabaseService
DatabaseService extends Kysely<Database> and connects using process.env.DATABASE_URL
types.ts defines Database interface with tables: organizations, users, projects, tasks, comments, notifications, audit_logs
Every table interface except organizations includes tenant_id: string
Generated<> is used ONLY on id, created_at, updated_at, is_active, read columns
users.role is typed as 'Admin' | 'ProjectManager' | 'Member'
projects.status is typed as 'Active' | 'Archived'
tasks.status is typed as 'ToDo' | 'InProgress' | 'Completed'
001_initial.ts creates ALL tables with correct columns, foreign keys, ON DELETE rules, unique constraints, check constraints, and indexes exactly as specified in the PRD
organizations.name is UNIQUE
users.email is UNIQUE and index exists on (tenant_id) and (email)
projects has UNIQUE (tenant_id, name) and index on (tenant_id)
tasks has indexes on (tenant_id), (project_id), (assigned_to)
comments has indexes on (tenant_id), (task_id)
migrate.ts runs all pending migrations on application bootstrap
app.module.ts imports DatabaseModule

title: Authentication Module
description: Implements registration, login, refresh token flow, JWT strategy, role decorators, and global JWT guard.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/auth/register is decorated with @Public()
RegisterDto has email: @IsEmail(), password: @MinLength(8), first_name: @IsString() @Length(1,100), last_name: @IsString() @Length(1,100), organization_name: @IsString() @Length(1,150)
Register endpoint creates organization and user in a single transaction
Role is hardcoded to 'Admin' and never accepted from request body
Password is hashed using bcrypt with 12 salt rounds
Email uniqueness is enforced and duplicate returns ConflictException
Successful register returns { id, email, first_name, last_name, role: 'Admin', tenant_id }
POST /api/auth/login is decorated with @Public()
LoginDto has email: @IsEmail(), password: @IsString()
Invalid credentials throw UnauthorizedException
Successful login returns { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, first_name, last_name, role, tenant_id } }
POST /api/auth/refresh is decorated with @Public() and returns new { access_token, refresh_token }
JWT payload contains { sub, email, role, tenant_id }
jwt.strategy validate() returns { id, email, role, tenant_id }
Global JWT guard is registered using APP_GUARD in app.module.ts
@Roles() decorator sets metadata and RolesGuard enforces exact role match
@Public() decorator bypasses JWT guard
AuthController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
AuthModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Organizations Module
description: Allows authenticated Admins to create new organizations with an initial Admin user and receive an access token.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/organizations requires @Roles('Admin')

CreateOrganizationDto has name: @IsString() @Length(1,150), admin_email: @IsEmail(), admin_password: @MinLength(8), admin_first_name: @IsString() @Length(1,100), admin_last_name: @IsString() @Length(1,100)
Organization name must be unique or throw ConflictException
Admin user created with role 'Admin' and password hashed with bcrypt 12 rounds
Endpoint returns { organization: { id, name }, access_token }
All writes occur in a transaction
OrganizationsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
OrganizationsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Users Module
description: Implements tenant-scoped user listing and role management with strict Admin-only access.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/users requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/users supports query params page and limit with defaults page=1, limit=20, max limit=100
GET /api/users returns { data: User[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
Each query includes .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
Only users with is_active = true are returned
PATCH /api/users/:id/role requires @Roles('Admin')
UpdateUserRoleDto has role: @IsIn(['ProjectManager','Member'])
Cannot assign 'Admin' role and cannot modify own role else throw ForbiddenException
User not found within tenant throws NotFoundException
UsersController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
UsersModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Projects Module
description: Provides tenant-scoped project CRUD operations with role-based permissions and pagination.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/projects requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateProjectDto has name: @IsString() @Length(1,150), description: @IsOptional() @IsString() @MaxLength(1000), status: @IsOptional() @IsIn(['Active','Archived'])
Project name must be unique per tenant or throw ConflictException
GET /api/projects is accessible to all authenticated users
GET /api/projects returns paginated { data, meta } format
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
PATCH /api/projects/:id requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
UpdateProjectDto allows optional name, description, status with same validations
Updating project from different tenant throws NotFoundException
ProjectsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
ProjectsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Tasks Module
description: Implements task management within projects including assignment, status updates, and tenant enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/tasks requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')

CreateTaskDto has project_id: @IsUUID(), title: @IsString() @Length(1,150), description: @IsOptional() @IsString(), assigned_to: @IsOptional() @IsUUID(), status: @IsOptional() @IsIn(['ToDo','InProgress','Completed'])
Project must belong to tenant or throw NotFoundException
assigned_to must belong to same tenant or throw BadRequestException
GET /api/tasks requires query param project_id and returns paginated { data, meta }
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
PATCH /api/tasks/:id allows Admin and ProjectManager, or Member only if task.assigned_to === req.user.id
Members cannot modify project_id
Updating task from different tenant throws NotFoundException
TasksController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
TasksModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Comments Module
description: Enables authenticated users to create and manage task comments with strict ownership and tenant checks.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/comments is accessible to all authenticated users
CreateCommentDto has task_id: @IsUUID(), content: @IsString() @Length(1,2000)
Task must belong to tenant or throw NotFoundException
Comment is saved with user_id = req.user.id and tenant_id = req.user.tenant_id
GET /api/comments?task_id=uuid returns paginated { data, meta } and filters by tenant_id
DELETE /api/comments/:id only allowed if comment.user_id === req.user.id else throw ForbiddenException
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
CommentsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
CommentsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Dashboard and Notifications Module
description: Provides aggregated dashboard metrics and tenant-scoped notifications with pagination and read tracking.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/dashboard returns { total_projects, total_tasks, tasks_by_status: { ToDo, InProgress, Completed } } scoped by tenant_id
All dashboard queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
GET /api/notifications returns paginated { data, meta } filtered by tenant_id and user_id = req.user.id
PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read marks notification.read = true only if notification.user_id === req.user.id else throw ForbiddenException
All notification queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
DashboardController and NotificationsController have NO @UseGuards() decorator
Both modules are added to app.module.ts imports

title: Audit Logs Module
description: Implements tenant-scoped audit logging and Admin-only access to paginated audit records.
acceptance_criteria: Audit logs table is used to record { id, tenant_id, user_id, action, entity, entity_id, created_at }
Service exposes method logAction(tenant_id, user_id, action, entity, entity_id) inserting record
GET /api/audit-logs requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/audit-logs returns paginated { data, meta } filtered by tenant_id
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
AuditLogsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
AuditLogsModule is added to app.module.ts imports
